text: Which statement about linear independence is correct?
choices: Any set containing the zero vector is linearly dependent
A set is independent as soon as no vector is a scalar multiple of another
An infinite set is independent if at least one finite subset is independent
The union of two independent sets is independent
explanation: 1·0 = 0 is a nontrivial dependence, so 0 can never belong to an independent set. Pairwise checks do not suffice — (1,0), (0,1), (1,1) are pairwise non-proportional yet dependent — and independence of an infinite set requires EVERY finite subset to be independent.
